event_type.description: Transaction action name, such as CreateNewEcosystem, UpdateCredentialSchema, or StartParticipantOP.

did.description: Primary DID of the event resource. Null for events with no DID or Corporation affiliation (Exchange Rate and module-parameter messages), which only reach unfiltered queries and wildcard subscriptions.

proposal_id.description: Set only on a Msg executed by an x/group proposal: the id of that proposal.

proposal_message_index.description: Set only on a Msg executed by an x/group proposal: its position in the proposal. A client that deduplicates on tx_hash and message_index must add proposal_id and proposal_message_index, since one executing Msg emits an event per wrapped Msg.
